popCulture.title: Bibliotheca (Medus)
popCulture.creator: Apollodorus
popCulture.description: Apollodorus’ handbook makes Medus the son Medea bore to Aegeus — exiled with his mother after the plot against Theseus, he gives his name to the Medes.

popCulture.title: Medus
popCulture.description: Eponym of the Medes in the Medea cycle — Aegeus’ son (or, in some strands, Jason’s) who conquers barbarian lands after fleeing Athens.
